item.title: Researchers Demonstrate Ghostscript Sandbox-Escape RCE via Crafted File Uploads in Popular Apps
item.description: A now-patched flaw in Ghostscript allows a crafted file to escape the program's security sandbox and run commands on the server that processes it. Ghostscript is the interpreter that many Linux servers use to convert uploaded PDFs, PostScript files, and images into other formats, often without the application calling it directly. Security firm pwn.ai showed this week that ordinary upload…

item.description: A malicious webpage could extract a Meta Muse user's private conversations and stored memories from the assistant without triggering any approval prompt, researchers have shown. The same attack could be extended to reach the credentials Muse stores for the user's connected accounts. The work was a laboratory demonstration, not an attack on real users, and it stayed inside the individual user's…

item.title: GnuPG Warns Critical GPGME Flaw Could Expose App Data via Malicious OpenPGP Keys
item.description: A malicious OpenPGP key with an unusually long user ID can trigger a critical memory bug in GPGME, the standard library that programs use to work with GnuPG. The GnuPG project warned yesterday that the flaw could be used to steal data from affected applications and has released fixed versions. The bug, tracked as CVE-2026-129975, affects all software that uses GPGME before version 2.3.0…

item.description: Suspected China-linked hackers used autonomous AI agents to find a previously unknown flaw in MONAI Label, an open-source medical imaging server, and gain root access to a university server, Amazon Threat Intelligence said this week. The flaw allows an attacker with no account to write files outside the server's storage folder, and it affects MONAI Label 0.8.5 and earlier in the default setup…

item.title: CTO of ‘RansomwareHelp’ Indicted for Wire Fraud
item.description: The chief technology officer and co-founder of ransomwarehelp.com, a six year old Florida business that claimed to use "advanced cryptographic tools" to restore data locked by ransomware, has been charged with wire fraud after an FBI sting operation found the company was simply paying the attackers for a decryption key and charging victims a markup for work that was never performed.

item.description: Meta-owned WhatsApp has addressed security vulnerabilities, including one impacting its Android app that it suspects may have been exploited in connection with scam messages. On a shared server, that memory can include other customers' virtual machines. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-99312, affects only hosts with AMD processors and nested virtualization enabled.
